name: horizonaid
description: Varbase functional testing suite (varbase-e2e) for the Horizon Aid site template recipe.

scripts.test:ci: cucumber-js --config cucumber.js --tags "not @wip and not @flaky and not @skip"
scripts.test:hotfix: cucumber-js --config cucumber.js --tags "(@smoke or @critical) and not @wip and not @flaky"
scripts.test:production: cucumber-js --config cucumber.js --tags "@production and not @wip and not @slow"
